changes: Accept route and direct adapter take project quota then hold writable project FOR SHARE through invitation/member/receipt commit. Replay follows same lifecycle guard and locks current membership; archive wins or acceptance wins are tested on observed distinct PostgreSQL connections.

Leave route and direct adapter take project quota before actor/project/member/receipt locks. Route checks current owner/self membership before receipt; archived leave and identical replay remain possible. Owner and unrelated nonmember cannot leave.

Expired accept no longer COMMITs a caller-owned adapter transaction. The HTTP route explicitly owns/persists its expired status update, preserving prior API behavior while direct callers may roll back unrelated work.
Invitation list now uses strict additive limit/cursor/status query schema, descending created_at/id keyset with microsecond timestamp anchors, signed current-scope cursors and default50/max100 page.
List rows add safe delivery status and role/lifecycle-aware retry eligibility; no new raw provider error/body/token/private recipient fields. Existing authorized email field remains unchanged.

Terminal delivery, permanent refusal, exhausted retries and superseded attempts retain only trusted same-project/workspace invitationId plus optional provider ID. Association is copied only if it matches a real invitation record; unknown/foreign associations are omitted and legacy missing associations remain unknown.
Migration0022 adds matching history and latest-delivery expression indexes; one page CTE plus bounded indexed lateral lookup avoids per-invitation application queries.
